Name: (CP) Configurable Colourful Wrapped Tools
Author: TeaLovingLad
Description:
This content pack simply overlays wrappings on tools without replacing the base sprites. This may lead to potential synergies with
other tool reskin mods, as long as they don't change the base shape of the tools significantly. Feel free to experiment!

If you are currently using the previous version of this mod [i]([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12354]Tool Reskin - Wrapped Handles[/url])[/i], then it's best to delete it, since this new version covers more tools and offers an easier solution to swap/apply wrappings.

[b]Feel free to use this mod's files, including images, as a base for configurable tool reskin mods or other possible plans! You have my full permission.[/b]


[size=5][b]This mod features...[/b][/size]

11 colours to choose from (see preview images), configurable per tool type, tier or all at once with the help of [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]!

Toggleable wrappings and changeable colour of the wrappings for the following tools:
[list]
[*]Axes
[*]FIshing Poles
[*]Hoes
[*]Milk Pail
[*]Pans
[*]Pickaxes
[*]Return Scepter
[*]Slingshots (Added with 1.1.0)
[*]Shears
[*]Scythes
[*]Trash Cans
[*]Watering Cans
[/list]3 extra spaces for custom colours, which you can edit to your liking within the mod's files. Once edited, you can choose either "Custom 1", "Custom 2" or "Custom 3" in the config menu to apply them in-game.


[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]

[size=3]- Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
- Download the mod via [u]"Manual Download"[/u] from the "Files"-tab
- Unpack the .zip file with your program of choice (e.g. [url=https://www.7-zip.de/]7-Zip[/url]) into the "Mods" folder

[/size]You should be able to configure the settings of this mod in the mod config menu, if done correctly.


[b][size=5]Available languages
[/size][/b]
[u]If you wish to contribute translations[/u] for your native language through i18n, [u]feel free to contact me[/u] here or on the main Stardew Valley Discord!

- English
- German


[b][center]Thank you for at least considering to download this mod.
Have a good one of whatever you feel like![/center][/b]
